scope: warm in-process Python decision on every frozen validation snapshot; not browser, cloud or simulator latency
method_order: alternating by repetition, fixed sorted episode order
timed_work: fresh analytical five-lead estimate + feature construction + original JSON model/hash validation + candidate choice
excluded_work: file loading, source/selection provenance audits, fitting, simulator execution, UI and network

analytical.percentile_method: nearest rank ceil(0.95*n) over timing calls, not traffic episodes

learned.percentile_method: nearest rank ceil(0.95*n) over timing calls, not traffic episodes
